cohort: The study included 60 patients with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and osteoarthritis, divided into a control group (routine care) and a research group (cluster-based care).
finding: Cluster-based care significantly reduced negative mood (anxiety and depression), increased care satisfaction, and lowered the incidence of perinatal complications compared to routine care.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the modes of delivery between the group receiving routine care and the group receiving cluster-based care.
